The member session was denied both owner-only billing operations with the expected 403 FORBIDDEN response.
The evidence does not include a completed subscription lifecycle, refund, dispute or webhook replay run.
The temporary acceptance bootstrap was disabled and its secret variable was deleted after the run.

humanDecision.reason: Authenticated hosted Checkout, Portal and member authorization are verified. The full 6.10 lifecycle, refund, dispute and webhook replay evidence is still missing.
